name: Seikosha
description: Seikosha was the fourth planet in the Breago system, a star system located in the Trans-Hydian Borderlands region of the Outer Rim Territories. Cryospac Repulsorlift Corporation, who produced the Model 90 Ranger landspeeder, was based on the planet.
lead_paragraphs: Seikosha was the fourth planet in the Breago system, a star system located in the Trans-Hydian Borderlands region of the Outer Rim Territories. Cryospac Repulsorlift Corporation, who produced the Model 90 Ranger landspeeder, was based on the planet.
